title: Reverse Sentence · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Reverse Sentence · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner says a short three-word sentence. The lead repeats the same three words in reverse order. All three words appear in exact reverse order. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: None.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Reverse Sentence, what counts as a successful turn?
options: All three words appear in exact reverse order.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: All three words appear in exact reverse order.
